title: Neutral Interchange Document
description: The ONLY object crossing the engine to Jira-sink interface (Constitution VIII). Built by the engine, schema-validated before any write. Carries zero Jira identifiers: logical/neutral values only; the sink resolves them to ids. Any Atlassian-specific identifier appearing here is a schema violation.

schema_version.description: Neutral document schema version; bumped in the same change that alters this schema.

project_key.description: Resolved by the engine from routing rules. A project KEY (public within the org), never a site URL, id, or coordinate.

local_id.description: Engine-local id, stable across runs; NOT a Jira key.

title.description: Derived from the title ladder (FR-013); never empty, never from a ## Summary section.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given/When/Then blocks (FR-015). Each clause is an inline sequence (feature 016), not a plain string — this replaces the crude global asterisk strip at engine/parse.sh:199, the partial workaround for the reported defect.

design.description: Figma links and UX/UI guidance for the Design section (FR-016).

value.description: An inline sequence when kind is 'guidance' (feature 016); stays a plain string URL when kind is 'figma_link' (a URL is not prose).

priority_logical.description: Spec priority; the sink maps it to the project's priority field by logical name (FR-017). Never a Jira priority id.

estimation.description: Declared estimation, create-only; the sink writes it to the discovered estimation field and never re-sends on update (FR-018).

task.description: A mirrored tasks.md line (feature 012). The `relation`/`link_type_logical` pair below is feature 001's original, never-implemented shape; 012 mirrors every task as a sub-task, so both stay optional rather than being invented as required.

local_id.description: 16 hex characters, or empty when the marker state is 'absent'.

task_ref.description: The task's own reference as written in tasks.md (T014, T014a).

description.description: The task's own text as marked spans. Feature 016 FR-017: a task line is author prose and obeys the same inline model every other description position obeys — a paragraph here carries `spans`, never a raw `text` string.

done.description: The checkbox state in tasks.md; drives the completion transition (012 FR-033).

marker.description: The durable task identifier spliced into tasks.md, in the shape engine/task_marker emits.

relation.description: Task strategy chosen explicitly in config (001 FR-009). Not emitted by 012, which always mirrors as a sub-task.

link_type_logical.description: Required iff relation = linked_story; logical link-type name resolved by the sink.

kind.description: Neutral formatting vocabulary (feature 016). Deliberately lexically distinct from ADF's strong/em/code/strike (Constitution VIII).

href.description: Absolute http(s) target. Required iff kind is 'link'. The pattern is the schema-level backstop for FR-006: a non-http target can never reach Jira as a live link, because a validation failure blocks every downstream write.

text.description: Literal characters a reader sees. Never carries the syntax of a converted construct (FR-002).

marks.description: Always present, [] when unmarked, sorted alphabetically by kind. Always-emitted and always-sorted so the two ports cannot differ by an omitted key or by source nesting order (FR-015).

inline.description: A sequence of marked runs (feature 016). Empty array represents empty text. Invariant not expressible in JSON Schema and enforced by the tokenizer instead (contract D1): no two consecutive spans carry equal marks.

content_blocks.description: A neutral, Jira-agnostic block tree. The sink renders it to ADF. NO ADF node names appear here.

type.description: Neutral block kinds. 'ordered_list' is new in feature 016 (FR-008). 'panel_ref' marks where the sink should place a panel (e.g. acceptance criteria); the engine does not know what a Jira panel is.

items.description: List items. Each item is an inline sequence (feature 016; was an array of plain strings before it).

text.description: Code block body ONLY. Deliberately plain: FR-007 forbids interpreting markup inside code, and keeping this position a string makes that a property of the schema rather than a rule the tokenizer must remember.

ref.description: For panel_ref: a logical section name, e.g. 'acceptance_criteria' or 'design'.
